_comment: Structural shape of the current Crunchyroll discover responses, captured
during controlled read-only discovery and reproduced here with SYNTHETIC
content. No real titles, ids, account data, tokens or cookies.
The defect: items carry `series_metadata` (and the movie equivalent),
while title/description live at the ITEM level. The candidate parser reads
that object, so live items are dropped (search) or degraded (browse).
`legacy` reproduces the older shape the candidate was written against and
exists to prove the fix does not regress it.

items.title: Synthetic Live Series
items.description: A synthetic series used only to pin the live response shape.

items.description: A synthetic movie listing used only to pin the live response shape.

_comment: Pre-BT0 behaviour: search included any item that HAD a legacy metadata
object, regardless of the title value. An empty-string title did not
make the item disappear. BT0 must not change that.
